svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 94 long, 50 wide, 50 high with a 20 bore along its length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue to the rear wall and floor so the bore lines up with the rear wall hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw a 2 mm slit along the top of the bore and fit one M4 x 30 clamp bolt across it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tail boom slides in until it meets the rear wall's inside face plus 6.
